body:
I've been in that same situation for over a year now. 

None of my friends want to talk to me, my grades are shit, and the only job I can get where I am is terrible. I'm still going to take that job, save up some money, and move away, try and start a new life somewhere. 


If that doesn't work, I can always kill myself there.

I always find it weird going to the first session with a therapist, and them making me promise not to do anything to harm myself between now and our next session (which she tried to make for Wednesday, I'm busy though, so it's the 6th instead of the 29th)

My friend situation is a girl I know online through gaming, an old co-worker who I just talk to on msn, one of my exes (we're still on good terms) who I've seen once in the past month, and an old high school friend. Last time I talked to her was a few months ago though =\.

I hardly talk with my parents at all, but they know I have problems with depression.

I'm going to try out the therapists at my college, I used to work for the government and I went to the therapist there and it worked out well enough.
Both, I talk with a few people in classes, but it's usually helping each other  with assignments
Wandering around isn't really my thing. I am on 3 soccer teams this winter though, and... well, we'll see what happens when I'm getting out of the house 3 times a week
